cat > wordcount.py <<'EOF'
def count_words(text: str) -> int:
    """Count words in text, ignoring comment lines (first non-blank char is '#')."""
    total = 0
    for line in text.splitlines():
        if line.lstrip().startswith('#'):
            continue
        total += len(line.split())
    return total
EOF
cat >> tests/test_wordcount.py <<'EOF'


def test_indented_comment_line_is_skipped():
    assert count_words('   \t# note here\nhello\n') == 1


def test_comment_marker_without_space_is_skipped():
    assert count_words('#note\nhello\n') == 1


def test_hash_mid_line_is_not_a_comment():
    assert count_words('hello # world\n') == 3


def test_words_split_on_any_whitespace_run():
    assert count_words('a  b\t\tc \n d') == 4


def test_empty_and_blank_text_has_no_words():
    assert count_words('') == 0
    assert count_words('  \n\t\n') == 0


def test_comment_only_text_has_no_words():
    assert count_words('# a\n  # b c\n') == 0
EOF
